items.context: A newsletter from a residents' association about recycling

items.prompt: Thanks to your efforts, the amount of rubbish sent to landfill this year is ___ lower than it was five years ago.

explanation.en: Much is used before a comparative to say that the difference is big. Very cannot modify a comparative.
explanation.es: Antes de un comparativo se usa «much», no «very».

items.prompt: Residents are reminded that glass goes in the green bin, ___ plastic goes in the blue one.

explanation.en: Whereas contrasts two facts in the same sentence. Despite needs a noun or -ing form, and unless means if not.

items.prompt: If everyone ___ their rubbish more carefully, we would reduce waste even further.

explanation.en: A second conditional with would in the main clause needs the past simple in the if-clause.
explanation.es: Con «would» en la principal, la cláusula con «if» va en pasado simple.

items.prompt: Please do not leave bags next to the bins, ___ they attract foxes.

explanation.en: Since gives a reason, here the reason for the request. So that gives a purpose and even if sets up a contrast.

items.prompt: Local shops will be fined if they fail ___ the new rules on plastic bags.

explanation.en: The verb fail is followed by to + infinitive.
